fee_notes: New franchise fee $48,500; transfer/training fee $35,000; additional center fee $35,000. Veteran discount: $10,000 off new center fee or $5,000 off transfer fee. $5,500 refundable deposit applied toward new franchise fee at closing.
raw_excerpt: If you purchase a new franchise, you must pay an initial franchise fee of $48,500 when you sign the Franchise Agreement. If you purchase an existing Center, you must pay Minuteman a Transfer/Training Fee of $35,000.
